definitions: To transfer an amount of money or a debt from one account or period to another.
To postpone or defer something to a later time or date.
To turn from one side to another, often in bed, facing towards something or someone.
examples: We decided to roll over to the next financial year.
The remaining balance will roll over to next month's bill.
She would often roll over to face the window.
The meeting was rolled over to Friday.
